security.coupon-lock-minutes-hint: How long code attempts stay locked.
security.allow-private-webhook-targets-hint: Lets webhooks call addresses inside your own network. Leave off unless you need it.

confirm-private.title: Allow Private Webhook Targets?
confirm-private.description: Webhooks will be able to call servers on your internal network. Anyone who can create a webhook could use this to reach them.

mail.title: E-Mail

host-too-old.title: Pano Is Too Old For Store E-Mail

mail.order-mails-hint: Subscription, expiry and bank-transfer mails are always sent.
mail.kinds-hint: Uncheck a mail to stop sending it. Service mails are marked.
mail.attach-invoice-hint: The invoice PDF is attached to the order confirmation.
mail.reply-to-hint: Replies to store mails go here. Leave empty for none.
mail.delivered-delay-hint: How long to wait before telling the buyer the order was delivered.

info.title: Server Settings Win
info.body: A server's local config file can still turn any feature off, and the market component must be installed on each server by hand.

vault-provider-warning.title: Every Economy Call Goes To Pano
vault-provider-warning.body: With Pano as the Vault economy every balance change needs a round trip to Pano and is refused while the server is disconnected. A compromised game server can move its players' credits.

feature-hint.store-command: /store prints the store link and the player's last purchases.
feature-hint.join-notifications: Tells players about deliveries that waited and gifts when they join.
feature-hint.store-menu: A chest menu with the catalogue (Spigot, Paper and Folia).
feature-hint.admin-commands: /panomarket commands to manage credits and purchases.
feature-hint.placeholders: Placeholders such as the credit balance and the top supporter.
feature-hint.broadcast: Announces every paid order to the server chat.

minecraft.admin-commands-list-hint: Uncheck a sub-command to switch it off.
minecraft.vault-mode-hint: How credits meet the server's Vault economy.

vault-hint.OFF: Credits and the server economy stay separate.
vault-hint.PROVIDER: Pano credits are the Vault economy of the server.
vault-hint.CONVERT: Players convert between credits and server money with /credits convert and /credits deposit.

servers-error.title: Server List Unavailable
servers-error.body: The servers could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

ip-trust.title: Proxy Not Configured
ip-trust.body: Requests arrive through a proxy but Pano does not trust it, so every visitor looks like the same address and rate limits cannot tell them apart.

webhooks.auto-disabled-hint: Turned off after too many failed deliveries in a row.
webhooks.toast-test-failed: Test failed (HTTP {status}). Open Deliveries for details.

confirm-delete.title: Delete Webhook?
confirm-delete.description: {name} will be deleted and its pending deliveries are dropped.

confirm-redeliver.title: Redeliver?
confirm-redeliver.description: The same event is sent again to the endpoint.

shipping-zones.first-match: Zones are checked from top to bottom and the first zone that matches the address is used. Put specific zones above general ones.
shipping-zones.shadowed: This zone can never match: an earlier active zone already covers all of its countries.

shipping-methods.no-rates-hint: This method has no rate rows, so it is not offered anywhere.

shipping-carriers.test-mode-hint: Carriers in test mode are used only for orders created by staff members with settings or order permissions.
shipping-carriers.no-plugins-body: Only the manual carrier is available. Install a carrier plugin from the store to buy labels and get live rates.
shipping-carriers.incompatible: This plugin uses shipping interface version {spiVersion}, which this store does not support. Update the plugin.
shipping-carriers.unavailable: The plugin of this carrier is not running. Its settings are kept.
shipping-carriers.unavailable-hint: Start the plugin to use this carrier again.
shipping-carriers.manual-locked: The manual carrier cannot be turned off.
